body: Sharan Bansal (Director / ED) on 2026-10-30 (Q2FY27 concall transcript): "at worst, we may see 1% or 2% drop from our 15% guidance" Metric: Consolidated revenue growth YoY. Target: +13-15% (needs ~+21-22% in H2). Deadline: 2027-03-31. Specificity: range; prompted by analyst. Status as of 2026-11-19: pending. Evidence: Needs H2 revenue of ~INR 3,400-3,450 cr vs H2FY26 3,037 cr.
